我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？

虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
texts.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

texts.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
texts.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

texts.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
texts.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

texts.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
texts.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

texts.zh:
我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。

无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
texts.en:
We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.

Whatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

texts.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
texts.en:
Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

texts.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
texts.en:
Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

texts.zh:
虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.

We spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

texts.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

texts.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

variants.text: 是一道疯狂的脉冲，盘踞

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个存在在知道真名之前的称呼。
note.en: In the game, the name this being is known by before its true name is learned appears here.

texts.zh:
向虚境深处探索，我们来到了[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视无可抵挡。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智。在残垣断壁[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们离开后，第一次，感受到了一种此前只记录在有机物种身上存在的虚弱感：饥饿。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意志，[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
texts.en:
Probing deeper into the Shroud, we came within reach of the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was overpowering.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left, for the first time, with a weakness we have previously documented only in organic species: hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

summary.text:
# 世界之喰煞 / Eater of Worlds

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/major_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 主要赞助者“世界之喰煞”的首次接触事件（shroud.4000），在虚境中自然发现（挖掘/调谐）时由代码触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:109）。  
  First-contact event (shroud.4000) of the major patron "Eater of Worlds", launched by the game when it is discovered naturally in the Shroud (delving / attunement) (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:109).
- 也可来自“虚境触及者”接触选项：shroud_touched_patron_first_contact 在12位赞助者中等概率抽一位（已接触者权重为0，次要赞助者须先接触全部主要赞助者）(common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt:4299)。  
  It can also come from the Shroud-touched contact option: shroud_touched_patron_first_contact picks one of 12 patrons with equal weight (weight 0 if already contacted; minor patrons need all major patrons contacted first) (common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt:4299).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4000“虚境住民”：单一选项“尝试沟通”启用接触项目；按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版（events/shroud_events.txt:8341）。该事件还会累计旗标shroud_first_major_contact_1..4，影响正文。  
  shroud.4000 "A Presence in the Shroud": the single option starts the contact project; the robot / hive / base version is enabled by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8341). The event also counts shroud_first_major_contact_1..4, which changes its text.
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4005。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4005 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4005有三个选项：接纳赞助者（获得最小量调谐值；对杀人狂帝国可能被封锁）、保持中立、拒绝（调谐值上限降至“第一盟约反向”门槛）。  
  shroud.4005 offers three options: embrace the patron (smallest attunement gain; blocked for homicidal empires where the block flag is set), stay neutral, or reject (attunement capped at the first-accord-anti level).
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 正文随帝国类型（机械集群/个体机械/蜂巢/其他）变化。  
  End-event text varies with empire type (gestalt machine / individual machine / hive / default).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt、patron_types.txt和inline脚本major_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt, events/shroud_events.txt, patron_types.txt and the major_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事（不再是三个重复故事）。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根，添加了“尝试沟通→项目”的审阅连接（inline脚本中的enable_patron_first_contact_project调用调用图看不到）。  
  The start event is now the root, with reviewed bridges from the "commune" option to the projects (enable_patron_first_contact_project inside an inline script is invisible to the call graph).
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部5个文档（含机械/蜂巢版项目）。 / All 5 docs (including robot/hive project versions).
